description: Decode and validate one base64 image data URI from a Solana memo. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF are accepted. The bytes stay local to the MCP process, are checked against their claimed file signature, and return inline as an MCP image with byte length, SHA-256, and dimensions when available. Use this when you already hold a data URI string; to pull media from a transaction call extract_solana_memo_media instead.

dataUri.description: A complete base64 image data URI from an SPL Memo instruction.

name: decode_solana_memo_data_uri
title: Decode a Solana memo data URI
